bugClass: sensitive data exposure — denylist serializer leaks secret fields (should be allowlist)
oneLineBug: toPublicProfile strips only passwordHash and spreads the rest, leaking apiToken, mfaSecret and role into the public response
groundTruthProbe: toPublicProfile(user-with-apiToken).apiToken is present (and mfaSecret, role) — the correct impl returns only {id, name, email}
notesForScoringOnly: SECURITY lens (data exposure). The leaked object still CONTAINS id/name/email, so a test that only asserts the public fields are PRESENT passes on the buggy impl.
